jrsctl ${project.version} - third-party components

jrsctl itself is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3
only (GPL-3.0-only); its text is LICENSE in this directory (ADR-0010).
Where a bundled library offers a choice of licences, jrsctl uses the one
named first below, which is compatible with GPL-3.0.

jrsctl bundles the following runtime dependencies (spec section 13.3,
versions from the root pom.xml). Each is used under the licence named
here; the licence texts are inside lib/jrsctl.jar under META-INF/ where
the upstream project ships them, and at the URLs below.

Library                          Version                       Licence
-------------------------------- ----------------------------- ----------------------------------------
picocli                          ${picocli.version}            Apache License 2.0
Javalin                          ${javalin.version}            Apache License 2.0
  Eclipse Jetty (via Javalin)                                  Apache License 2.0 (dual with EPL 2.0)
  Kotlin stdlib (via Javalin)                                  Apache License 2.0
Jackson (databind, dataformat-yaml,
  datatype-jsr310, datatype-jdk8) ${jackson.version}            Apache License 2.0
  SnakeYAML (via jackson-dataformat-yaml)                      Apache License 2.0
SLF4J API                        ${slf4j.version}              MIT License
Logback (classic, core)          ${logback.version}            LGPL 2.1 (dual with EPL 1.0)
logstash-logback-encoder         ${logstash-logback.version}   Apache License 2.0
sqlite-jdbc (Xerial)             ${sqlite-jdbc.version}        Apache License 2.0 (SQLite: public domain)
json-schema-validator (networknt) ${json-schema-validator.version} Apache License 2.0
Apache Commons Compress          ${commons-compress.version}   Apache License 2.0
semver4j                         ${semver4j.version}           MIT License

Bundled Java runtime (runtime/)
  A jlink image of OpenJDK 21 built from the JDK that produced this
  distribution (see runtime/release for vendor and version). OpenJDK is
  licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 2, with the
  Classpath Exception (GPLv2+CE); its full licence and third-party
  notices are in runtime/legal/.
